  is_shown = { always = yes }
  is_valid = { always = yes }
  effect = {
    set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4 value = 23 }
    if = {
      limit = { var:skonester_craft_m4 = 0 }
      set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4_cnt value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
      limit = { NOT = { var:skonester_craft_m4 = 0 } }
      if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = skonester_craft_m4_cnt } }
        set_variable = { name = skonester_craft_m4_cnt value = 1 }
      }
    }
  }
}

skonester_acm_gui_sel_m4_v23 = {
  scope = character
  is_shown = {
    var:skonester_craft_m4 = 23
  }
  is_valid = { always = yes }
